1.5 year

https://www.linkedin.com/in/dhruvin-dedhia-19a21720a?utm_source=share&utm_campaign=share_via&utm_content=profile&utm_medium=android_app

compliance work is soul-crushing... checking boxes, following rules made by people who've never done the actual work. makes sense you want out.
